ValidationRule.description: When the indexation is accepted, the user must provide values before passing to status Negotiation Done
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
(
$Profile.Name<>'System Administrator'
&& $Profile.Name<>'Global Delegated Admin'
&& ISPICKVAL(Indexation_Status__c, "Negotiation Done")
&& ISBLANK(Indexation_Percentage_Accepted__c)
&& ISPICKVAL(Mutual_Termination_Status__c, "")
)
||
(
$Profile.Name<>'System Administrator'
&& $Profile.Name<>'Global Delegated Admin'
&& ISPICKVAL(Indexation_Status__c, "Negotiation Done")
&& ( ISBLANK(Communication_Date__c)
|| ISBLANK(Indexation_Percentage_Communicated__c)
|| ISPICKVAL(Means_of_communication__c, ""))
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide at least one of the following fields : Indexation Percentage Accepted, Mutual Termination Status. Make sure also that you have filled the communication fields: Communication Date, Indexation Rate Communicated, Means of communication
